ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Let the Earth's radius be R. According to the meaning of the problem, the height of Dongfanghong-1 at apogee is about 2060 km, so its distance to the center of the Earth is R+2060 km; Dongfanghong-2 is in a geosynchronous orbit, with a height of 35786 km, so the orbital radius is R+35786 km. The satellite's acceleration is provided by universal gravitation, with magnitude a=GM/r^2. Because R+2060 km < R+35786 km, the gravitational acceleration at the apogee of Dongfanghong-1 is greater than the gravitational acceleration of Dongfanghong-2, that is, a1>a2. Next compare a2 and a3: Dongfanghong-2 is a geosynchronous satellite, and it has the same angular velocity as the Earth's rotation, let it be ω; an object fixed on the Earth's equator also rotates with the Earth at the same angular velocity ω. Therefore the centripetal acceleration of Dongfanghong-2 is a2=ω^2(R+35786 km), and the centripetal acceleration of the equatorial object is a3=ω^2R. Since R+35786 km > R, a2>a3. Combining gives a1>a2>a3.
